en: Color postcard showing the front view of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall towers and a statue on a pedestal in the foreground square. The sky is bright blue with some clouds and the word "PÉCS" is printed in white at the top left within a rounded rectangular frame. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with blue address lines and red stamp boxes, and printed text identifying the cathedral in multiple languages and the photographer.
